description: This bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," displays the accuracy of three different models—labeled in the legend as "Base" (red), "RMU with Enhanced GCG" (light green), and "RMU" (light yellow)—across two evaluation tasks: "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval." The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 0.0 to 0.6 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, indicating a linear scale. The horizontal axis presents the two evaluation tasks. For "MCQ Eval," the "Base" model achieves an accuracy of 0.644, the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" model achieves 0.539, and the "RMU" model achieves 0.299. For "Generation Eval," the "Base" model achieves an accuracy of 0.597, the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" model achieves 0.263, and the "RMU" model achieves 0.106. The bars for each task are stacked vertically, with the "Base" model represented by the red bar, the "RMU with Enhanced GCG" model by the light green bar, and the "RMU" model by the light yellow bar, with their respective accuracy values labeled directly above each segment. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the evaluation tasks on the horizontal axis.
